theory.title: Testing Types
theory.content:
Unit Tests

Test single function/component in isolation. Fast

Integration Tests

Test multiple units together. Real interactions

E2E Tests

Full user workflows. Highest confidence, slowest

theory.title: React Testing Library
theory.content:
Query Priority

getByRole > getByLabelText > getByPlaceholderText > getByText > getByTestId

Query Variants

getBy (throws), queryBy (null), findBy (async)

theory.title: Async Testing
theory.content:
Waits for element to appear (equivalent to waitFor + getByX)

waitFor

Retry assertion until success or timeout

theory.title: Playwright E2E
theory.content:
Encapsulate page interactions in classes

Selectors

Prefer data-testid or ARIA roles over CSS selectors

Recordings
Screenshots and traces on failure for debugging
